meaning: Leakage protection activated: the safety switch has detected water in the base of the dishwasher.
causes: Water collected in the base of the dishwasher
diySteps: Turn off the water inflow to the dishwasher
Contact Bosch Customer Support for assistance
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: Bosch says to turn off the water inflow and contact Bosch Customer Support; the leak needs finding and fixing before you run it again.
sourceTitle: Bosch Dishwasher Error Codes: Troubleshooting Guide (Bosch)
